\chapter{Boolean Analysis — Elementary}
%%% generated by the blueprint pipeline from TCSlib.BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.Applications.KKL.Elementary
\section{Overview}
Elementary influence inequalities bound maxima and noisy Fourier energy on the Boolean cube. A dimension-dependent approximation by real-valued juntas complements the exponential Boolean junta theorem.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{lemma}[Noisy influence upper bound]
\lean{KKL.noisyInfluence_le_influence}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.influence, BooleanAnalysis.influence_eq_sum_fourier, KKL.noisyInfluence}
\difficulty{4}
\label{KKL.noisyInfluence_le_influence}
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube, $i\in[n]$, and $0\le\rho\le1$. Then $I_i^{(\rho)}(f)\le I_i(f)$. For a real cube function $h$, define $I_i(h)=\tfrac14\mathbb E_x(h(x)-h(x^{(i)}))^2$, where $x^{(i)}$ flips coordinate $i$ and $\mathbb E_x$ is uniform expectation.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Boolean noisy influence upper bound]
\lean{KKL.noisyInfluence_power_bound}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.influence, BooleanAnalysis.isPmOne, KKL.noisyInfluence, KKL.noisyInfluence_le_influence}
\difficulty{1}
\label{KKL.noisyInfluence_power_bound}
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube, $i\in[n]$, and $0<\rho\le1$. Then $I_i^{(\rho)}(f)\le I_i(f)$. For a real cube function $h$, define $I_i(h)=\tfrac14\mathbb E_x(h(x)-h(x^{(i)}))^2$, where $x^{(i)}$ flips coordinate $i$ and $\mathbb E_x$ is uniform expectation.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Influence Cauchy--Schwarz inequality]
\lean{KKL.cauchy_schwarz_influences}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.influence, BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence}
\difficulty{3}
\label{KKL.cauchy_schwarz_influences}
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube. Then $I(f)^2\le n\sum_iI_i(f)^2$. For a real cube function $h$, define $I_i(h)=\tfrac14\mathbb E_x(h(x)-h(x^{(i)}))^2$, where $x^{(i)}$ flips coordinate $i$ and $\mathbb E_x$ is uniform expectation, and $I(h)=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}I_i(h)$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Large influence from squared influences]
\lean{KKL.max_influence_from_sum_sq}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.influence, BooleanAnalysis.influence_eq_sum_fourier, BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence}
\difficulty{5}
\label{KKL.max_influence_from_sum_sq}
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube with $I(f)>0$. There exists $i\in[n]$ with $I_i(f)\ge\sum_jI_j(f)^2/I(f)$. For a real cube function $h$, define $I_i(h)=\tfrac14\mathbb E_x(h(x)-h(x^{(i)}))^2$, where $x^{(i)}$ flips coordinate $i$ and $\mathbb E_x$ is uniform expectation, and $I(h)=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}I_i(h)$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{theorem}[Average coordinate influence bound]
\lean{KKL.KKL_trivial}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.influence, BooleanAnalysis.max_influence_lower_bound, BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence}
\difficulty{1}
\label{KKL.KKL_trivial}
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube in dimension $n>0$. Then some $i\in[n]$ satisfies $I_i(f)\ge I(f)/n$. For a real cube function $h$, define $I_i(h)=\tfrac14\mathbb E_x(h(x)-h(x^{(i)}))^2$, where $x^{(i)}$ flips coordinate $i$ and $\mathbb E_x$ is uniform expectation, and $I(h)=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}I_i(h)$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{definition}[Noisy degree-weighted Fourier energy]
\lean{KKL.noisyTotalInfluence}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.fourierCoeff}
\label{KKL.noisyTotalInfluence}
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube and $\rho\in\mathbb R$. Define $N_\rho(f)=\sum_{S\subseteq[n]}|S|\rho^{2|S|}\widehat f(S)^2$.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Dimension-dependent real junta approximation]
\lean{KKL.friedgut_junta}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BoolCube, BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.expect, BooleanAnalysis.isPmOne, BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence, BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence_eq_sum_sq_deg, BooleanAnalysis.uniformWeight, KKL.IsJunta, KKL.influentialCoords, KKL.influential_coords_card, KKL.l2DistSq, KKL.lowDegreePart, KKL.lowDegreePart_depends_on_influential, KKL.lowDegree_approx}
\difficulty{6}
\label{KKL.friedgut_junta}
\statementsource{boolean-ch10-advanced-hypercontractivity}{pdf-9d1751394783-p013-b001}
\statementsource{boolean-ch09-hypercontractivity-kkl}{
  pdf-4ba63c9394e5-p023-b003,
  pdf-4ba63c9394e5-p022-b003,
  pdf-4ba63c9394e5-p022-b004,
  pdf-4ba63c9394e5-p023-b001
}
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube and $\varepsilon>0$. There exist $J\subseteq[n]$ and $g:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ depending only on $J$, with $|J|\le4nI(f)/\varepsilon$ and $\mathbb E(f-g)^2\le\varepsilon$. For a real cube function $h$, define $I_i(h)=\tfrac14\mathbb E_x(h(x)-h(x^{(i)}))^2$, where $x^{(i)}$ flips coordinate $i$ and $\mathbb E_x$ is uniform expectation, and $I(h)=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}I_i(h)$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{lemma}[Balanced total influence lower bound]
\lean{KKL.balanced_totalInfluence_ge_one}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.expect, BooleanAnalysis.fourierCoeff, BooleanAnalysis.fourierCoeff_empty, BooleanAnalysis.isPmOne, BooleanAnalysis.parseval_pm_one, BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence, BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence_eq_sum_sq_deg}

\label{KKL.balanced_totalInfluence_ge_one}
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube with $n>0$ and $\mathbb Ef=0$. Then $I(f)\ge1$. For a real cube function $h$, define $I_i(h)=\tfrac14\mathbb E_x(h(x)-h(x^{(i)}))^2$, where $x^{(i)}$ flips coordinate $i$ and $\mathbb E_x$ is uniform expectation, and $I(h)=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}I_i(h)$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Nonnegative influence entropy]
\lean{KKL.influence_entropy_nonneg}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.influence, BooleanAnalysis.influence_eq_sum_fourier, BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence}
\difficulty{4}
\label{KKL.influence_entropy_nonneg}
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube with $I(f)>0$. Then $\sum_i[I_i(f)/I(f)]\log(I(f)/I_i(f))\ge0$, with zero influences contributing zero. For a real cube function $h$, define $I_i(h)=\tfrac14\mathbb E_x(h(x)-h(x^{(i)}))^2$, where $x^{(i)}$ flips coordinate $i$ and $\mathbb E_x$ is uniform expectation, and $I(h)=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}I_i(h)$.
\end{lemma}
